newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy evacuates 400 people from Albania.
newsitem.headline: Italy evacuates 400 people from Albania.

text.p: Italy was evacuating some 400 foreign nationals, 330 of them Italians, from Albania on Thursday as the Balkan state descended into anarchy, diplomatic sources said.

They said the evacuees were being ferried to Italian navy ships in the Adriatic Sea by helicopters from two air fields near the Albanian port of Durres. "The operation is still in progress," one source said.

The sources said the evacuees included about 70 non-Italians but could not specify nationalities. More than 70 Italians and other nationals were moved to safety in three Italian helicopter missions to the Albanian port of Vlore in the past 11 days.

U.S. forces in the Adriatic were also poised for a possible evacuation of Americans from Albania because of worsening instability in the small Balkan country and Britain was preparing to evacuate some 120 British and other nationals.

Albania, rocked by armed unrest, slid towards anarchy on Thursday as arms depots in several towns including the capital Tirana were looted and people used the weapons to raid food warehouses for emergency stockpiles.

Italy, Albania's closest economic partner, had about 1,900 of its nationals in the country before this month. Diplomatic sources said that all but 350 to 400 had left on commercial flights and ferries before Thursday.
